questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn in the direction of the arrow. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will be merging into your lane. Check your mirrors and sides, then move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers a safe path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead becomes slippery when it rains or is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show rules you must follow. This sign means do not pass other vehicles under any circumstances.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a yield sign is coming. Start slowing down when you see this warning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it travels slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, construction vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It looks solid orange during the day and appears as a red hollow triangle at night.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about conditions right ahead. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and get ready to yield or stop before you turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on vehicles that travel slowly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It tells you the road will turn sharply to the right, then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should slow down and move to the right lane.
Stay in the right lane if you are driving more slowly than other traffic.
Slower traffic must exit on the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in the right lane if you are driving more slowly than other traffic.
questions.explanation: This white rectangular sign shows a traffic rule you must follow. It means slower drivers should use the right lane and keep the left lane open for passing and faster traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign warns you of a railroad crossing ahead. It is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings alerts you to possible hazards. It tells you to watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings warns you of upcoming hazards. It alerts you that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign forbids right turns. You cannot turn right at an intersection where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings warns you of hazards that may not be obvious. It tells you a steep hill is coming. Slow down and adjust your speed to avoid accidents and brake problems.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign shows a traffic law you must obey. It tells you that U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings shows a crosswalk ahead, whether it is marked on the road or not. Stay alert and let pedestrians cross safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a steep downgrade ahead. Check your brakes before going down the hill.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow diamond signs with black markings warn you of upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you that traffic will be merging from the right. Be ready to make room for these vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange diamond signs mark construction and maintenance areas ahead. They help drivers and pedestrians stay safe in these work zones. Speeding fines are often doubled in areas marked with these signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools to warn drivers to slow down and watch carefully for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangle pointing downward is always a yield sign. You must be ready to slow down or stop when you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs warn you that a school zone or school crossing is near or ahead. Watch for children and follow the posted speed limits in these areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turning on a red signal is prohibited.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turning on a red signal is prohibited.
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells drivers what traffic laws they must follow. When posted at an intersection, it means you cannot turn right or left when the light is red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guards signals for you to go.
Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means a school is nearby. Be alert and stop if you see children in the crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns drivers of a school zone or school crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet. Drive carefully and reduce your speed in these conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: Yellow diamond warning signs have black markings. This sign means traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to make room for these vehicles.
